chip_types.csv.Name: Ascend 910B
chip_types.csv.Notes:
In terms of cost:

"distributors are selling the Huawei 910B at above 120,000 yuan per card, while its eight-card server equivalent starts at 1.3-1.5 million yuan per server" per Reuters. https://www.reuters.com/technology/nvidia-cuts-china-prices-huawei-chip-fight-sources-say-2024-05-24/

This is $16.5k at $0.138 USD per yuan in May 2024. Possible this is a relatively high street price compared to average (bulk) purchases. Rounding to 15k.

chip_types.csv.Name: Trainium1
chip_types.csv.Notes:
Trainium1 (and the very similar Inferentia2 chip) does not have an official TDP spec.

To estimate, note that AI chips generally become 40% more efficient per year: https://epoch.ai/data-insights/ml-hardware-energy-efficiency  

Trainium1/Inferentia2 and Trainium2 were separated by two years, suggesting a ~2x efficiency improvement based on trends.

Trainium2 is 500W and 667 TFLOP/s in 16-bit FLOP/s. Trainium1 is 190 TFLOP/s in 16-bit (note that the Trainium1 and Trainium2 have a slightly different ratio of 16-bit to 8-bit op/s; I'm using 16-bit which is likely more representative for Trainium1).

So Trainium1 TDP theoretically would be roughly 190/667 (compute ratio) * 500 W (Trainium2 wattage) * 2x (efficiency penalty for older chip) = 284W, rounded up to 300W.

chip_types.csv.Name: Ascend 910C
chip_types.csv.Notes:
Cost notes:

"Initial negotiations between Huawei and potential customers indicate that orders are likely to surpass 70,000 chips, with a total value of around $2 billion, according to the report." Implies average price of $28k, possibly including some system/auxiliary costs
https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/huawei-readies-new-ai-chip-challenge-nvidia-china-wsj-reports-2024-08-13 

In 2025, 910C CloudMatrix 384 reportedly $8 million, or ~$21k per GPU. 
This is a server cost, implying lower price per chip. 
https://www.trendforce.com/news/2025/07/21/news-huawei-to-unveil-cloudmatrix-384-rumored-to-deliver-2x-nvidia-gb200-nvl72-throughput/ 

Synthesizing at 20k each as a rough estimate.
